translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A sman̈ pensaril eb' tz'ac'anoch‘R’q'uen tumin yipoc sc'ool
Sb'it jun tic eb' yin̈tilal vin̈aj Coré.

content.text: Ex anima ay d'a masanil yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic, scham val eyab'an jun lolonel tic.
Ab'ec ex b'eyum yed' ex meb'a', mach ex ay eyelc'ochi yed' ex comon anima ex.
Ol in lolon d'a jelanil, ol val juntzan̈ pensar ajaltac snachajeli.
Ol in maclej val vab' slolonel eb' jelan. Ol in b'itej tas ix in c'ayb'ej chi' yed' sonal te' arpa.
¿Tas yuj ol in xivoc ayic ol ja juntzan̈ sc'ual yaelal d'ayin, ayic ol c'och oyan eb' ajc'ool d'ayin?
A eb' ajc'ol chi', a sb'eyumal eb' syac'och yipoc sc'ool, syic'anchaan̈ sb'a eb' yujto man̈ jantacoc tas ay d'a eb'.
Palta malaj junoc mach syal scolan yetanimail d'a yol yico', ma smananel sq'uinal d'a Dios.
Max yal-laj co mananel co q'uinal yic vach' ayon̈n̈ej eq'ui, yic max on̈ chami, yujto max techajlaj co tupani.
Ina squila' to junlajan scham anima smasanil. Scham eb' jelan, schampax eb' man jelanoc, axo sb'eyumal eb', ch'oc mach b'aj scani.
Vach'chom man̈ jantacoc co luum, palta nab'an̈ej. A b'aj tzon̈ mucchaji, ata' ayon̈n̈ejec' d'a masanil tiempo. Juneln̈ej ol on̈ cann̈ej ta'.
A on̈ anima on̈ tic, man̈ masaniloc tiempo ayon̈ec' d'a yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic. Vach'chom yel te b'eyum on̈, palta tzon̈ chamn̈ej icha scham noc' noc'.
Icha pax chi' tz'aj satel eb' syipc'olej sb'a, aton eb' syaloch sb'a vach'il.

A juntzan̈ anima chi', a chamel ayoch yilumaloc eb'. A tz'ic'anb'at eb' b'aj smucchaj chamnac. Ayic ol sacb'oc, d'a sc'ual yic ol on̈ ch'olb'itajoc, a eb' anima vach' spensar ol ac'an ganar d'a yichan̈ eb'. C'ojanc'olal ol satem snivanil eb', axo b'aj smucchaj chamnac ol och scajnub'oc eb'.
A in xo jun, a Dios ol in ic'ancanel d'a yol sc'ab' chamel, ol in yic'anb'at yed'oc.
Ex vetanimail, man̈ eyac' pensar yuj eb' tz'och b'eyumal, eb' ste q'uechaan̈ sb'eyumal d'a spat.
Yuj chi' man̈ e na'a, yujto ayic ol cham eb', malaj jab'oc tas ol yic'b'at eb' yed'oc, man̈ ol b'atlaj sb'eyumal eb' chi' yed'oc.
Vach'chom te tzalajc'olal yic eb' ayic pitzan eb', ma tz'alji pax vach' lolonel d'a eb' yuj eb' yetanimail yuj sb'eyumal chi',
ol ja sc'ual scham eb', icha ix aj scham eb' smam yicham eb', man̈xo ol yil-laj saquilq'uinal eb'.
A eb' anima b'eyum, tato max nachajel yuj eb' to eq'uelb'an̈ej yec' masanil tas, lajan ol aj scham eb' icha tz'aj scham noc' noc'.
